description: Decode an incoming request body and forward it to the routed handler, computing the Content-Length header; supports both a plain UTF-8 body and a Base64-encoded body.

cases.expected_output:
[request]
request.headers.content-type=application/json
request.headers.content-length=14
request.body={"greet":"hi"}
[response]
status=200
isBase64Encoded=false
body={"hello":"world2"}
header.connection=keep-alive
header.content-length=18
header.content-type=application/json; charset=utf-8
header.date=<present>

[request]
request.headers.content-type=application/json
request.headers.content-length=15
request.body={"greet":"hi"}
[response]
status=200
isBase64Encoded=false
body={"hello":"world2"}
header.connection=keep-alive
header.content-length=18
header.content-type=application/json; charset=utf-8
